summary: During the meeting, the committee voted to approve the consent agenda [08:50] and authorized a special event alcohol license [09:58]. Members of the public voiced concerns regarding reduced middle school library access under new scheduling models [17:03], [20:39] and lighting impacts near the local golf course and residential areas [25:15]. The superintendent presented a report on educational insights from Estonia [32:21] alongside district strategic goals focused on equity, multi-tiered systems of support, and curriculum alignment [34:36], [39:41]. Presentations covered the Lawrence School improvement work [1:00:06] and the BEEP preschool program, whose school improvement plan was formally approved [1:43:31]. The committee evaluated proposed town meeting warrant articles regarding outdoor light pollution regulations [2:05:09] and recorded a vote on the matter [2:32:08]. In addition, the board voted to approve the upcoming budget guidelines [2:38:20] and passed a motion to remove outdated philosophy statements from the district policy manual [2:44:06]. Subcommittee updates addressed ongoing capital facilities and shade structure projects [2:45:22], [2:48:26] before the committee voted to enter executive session to discuss collective bargaining and litigation [2:56:10].
